acceptance: When --record runs on a log file inside the repo/cwd, the recorded entry stores the repo-relative path rather than an operator-local absolute path (#629).
When --record runs on a log file outside the repo/cwd, logFile is omitted from the recorded manifest entry (#629).
When --record runs without ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY set, flail-detector prints a stderr warning noting that the entry is unsigned (#627).
description: In packages/flail-detector/bin/flail-detector.mjs, normalize logFile to a repo-relative POSIX path (or omit when outside the repo) when recording to the manifest ledger (#629), and warn on stderr when --record runs without ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY (#627).
title: flail-detector: normalize recorded logFile path and warn on unsigned --record (#627, #629)
